owner.rule: The successor request commit is separate and must not self-bind.

reviewedExecutionObjects.role: actual-shell success and rollback failure fixture

centralFreshReadRequiredBeforeLease: strict-known-hosts host identity, architecture, sudo capability, free space and same-filesystem guarantees
P0-236 signed lease, candidate.tgz and candidate finance.env exact tuple/bytes/SHA and no pending residue
current symlink literal path and resolved release; active root executable path/ELF/tuple/bytes/SHA
production environment tuple/bytes/SHA and exactly one YNX_FINANCE_WEB_DIR key without outputting values
systemd unit tuple/bytes/SHA plus exact ExecStart and WorkingDirectory
active Caddy root and Finance route tuple/bytes/SHA plus loopback upstream
state mode and every mutable Finance state path, or exact absence receipt
loopback and public health/version status, bytes, raw-body SHA and parsed old source identity
served public index and wallet-connect asset status, bytes and SHA
exact absence and safe parent tuples for lease-owned stage, backup and release paths

requestedSingleUseExecution.transport: one exact Central-signed non-secret deployment lease delivered by stdin to a Central-reviewed sudo bootstrap; no SCP and no environment-value output
actions: atomically install the exact signed deployment lease under /opt/ynx/leases/finance
verify archive and candidate environment against P0-236 receipts
validate the archive member list and embedded SHA256SUMS, reject absolute/traversal/symlink/device/extra members, and extract only into a lease-owned isolated stage
verify candidate ELF, complete file inventory and web assets before materialization
capture exact old environment/state/current/service rollback receipts before switch
atomically materialize the no-replace candidate release, atomically replace only the environment file, atomically switch current, and restart Finance exactly once
verify loopback and public health/version plus exact source-bound public index and wallet-connect assets

open the source-bound public Finance page read-only and prove stable URL, one top-level tab, no blank/custom-scheme navigation, console errors zero, distinct YNX Wallet and MetaMask identity/logo, and canonical chain 0x1917 without requesting an account

rollbackAndCleanupRequired: the first failure triggers exactly one rollback and makes the lease nonreusable
stop the candidate before state rollback; restore exact old environment bytes and exact old current target
for previously absent state, delete only if the stopped candidate path still matches the captured device and inode, then prove final absence before old service start
for existing state, restore only from the signed exact backup and verify tuple/bytes/SHA
restart the old service and prove old loopback/public health/version and MainPID/NRestarts terminal facts
remove pending/current.next/current.rollback and lease-owned stage/release/backup objects only after exact tuple/content rechecks; preserve substituted or foreign objects and fail closed
return exact success or rollback receipts, release Heavy and all path locks, and never retry
prohibitions: no deployment before a wholly new exact Central lease
no secret value in stdin metadata, logs or evidence
no eth_requestAccounts, approval, signature, typed data, transaction or private-key action
